itineraries.title: Five days on the Amalfi Coast
itineraries.intro: A short circuit of the Gulf of Naples and the Amalfi Coast, with the swims at Nerano and Li Galli that the day boats never reach.

days.note: Board at midday; a first swim off Capri’s Faraglioni, evening in the piazzetta.
The Blue Grotto before the queues; lunch on board at Marina Piccola.
A short morning crossing; the boutiques ashore, dinner on deck off the bay.
The cathedral steps; up to Villa Rufolo at Ravello for the evening light.
An early swim off Li Galli before the day boats, then a long lunch in Nerano; disembark in Naples.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Saint-Tropez to Monaco
itineraries.intro: The full Riviera: Pampelonne, the Lérins, Antibes, Villefranche and Monaco.

days.note: Board in Saint-Tropez; the Place des Lices.
Lunch at a beach club on the long sand, then the afternoon at anchor.
Board at the Vieux Port; La Croisette and the old town of Le Suquet before sailing.
The Picasso museum in the Grimaldi castle and the Provençal market.
The deep bay, Cocteau’s chapel and the citadel; dinner on the quay.
The Prince’s Palace, the oceanographic museum and the casino square.
